method.zscore: composite = mean of the available (-z_ndvi, -z_sm, z_eto, -z_imerg30), at least two, > 1.0; or two of z_ndvi < -1, z_sm < -1, z_eto > +1. California method A uses NDVI, LST, ESI and soil moisture; LST and ESI are not cached for BC, so thirsty air (ETo) and 30-day rain stand in.
method.z_scores: leave-one-year-out vs the same ISO week +/- 1 in other years of this field; z_sm from the GRACE-DA percentile
method.status: one / none (no second method); 'water' = water seen that week (never stress)
method.drivers: keys of the z-scores beyond 1 in the stress direction; `reasons` says the same in words

inputs.tmax: ECCC station mean (Salmon Arm CS, Silver Creek); NASA POWER T2M_MAX where no station reports
inputs.eto: Hargreaves (FAO-56 eq. 52) on station Tmax/Tmin, POWER where missing
inputs.imerg: NASA GPM IMERG V07 daily (backend/nasa imerg.parquet)
inputs.smap_pct: GRACE-DA GRACEDADM_CLSM025GL_7D rtzsm_inst percentile (SMAP not cached for BC)
inputs.ndvi_hls: field-median NDVI from backend/field calendar.json (Sentinel-2 first, then Landsat)

sources.title: NASA GPM IMERG daily precipitation V07 (Final run; Late run after the last Final day), 0.1 deg
NASA GRACE/GRACE-FO data-assimilation drought indicators (GRACEDADM_CLSM025GL_7D v3.0), 0.25 deg weekly
